name: @schoolos/releases
description: SchoolOS signed releases (roadmap R03): root-signed release manifests, release keys that change only through a key set signed by a threshold of offline root keys, release channels, signed offers the district verifies and approves, declines or defers, upgrades gated on the entitlement cache, and the root's staged rollout that halts on failing fleet health, offers rollback and counts district decisions. Its `./durable-object-store` entry point holds the Durable Object SQLite stores. A library, not a deployable Worker.
